summary: the imagerace cases concurrent and interrupted, run by their program, against faults in how krffs/mkimage.sh names its temporaries, ends on a signal and orders what it publishes; the script is the tree's own, since it finds the KRFFS tools beside itself

argv: sh tests/cases/host/imagerace.sh concurrent; a=$?; sh tests/cases/host/imagerace.sh interrupted; b=$?; [ $a = 0 ] && [ $b = 0 ]

faults.name: fixed-names
faults.summary: the temporary image has one name for every build, so two builds at once format, stage and rename one file

faults.name: signal-continues
faults.summary: a signal runs the cleanup and the build goes on, so a build stopped after it has staged publishes what the cleanup left and ends with status 0

edits.find:
"$OUT.programs.$$"' EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

lines: @etude 1 assert status fail builds stopped at these steps
@etude 1 assert current fail after builds stopped at these steps

faults.name: image-first
faults.summary: the image is renamed into place before its dependency file is written, so a build stopped between them leaves the new image beside the old dependency file

edits.find: # The staged inputs as a make dependency file beside the image.
edits.replace:
touch "$TMP"
mv "$TMP" "$OUT"

# The staged inputs as a make dependency file beside the image.

lines: @etude 1 assert matched fail builds stopped at these steps left the new image beside old lists
